title: HS30090: Agricultural Economics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: None Course ContentsEconomics of Agricultural Production:
Theoretical Foundation-Physical Relationships-The factor-Product Relationship,
The Factor-Factor Relationship, The Product-Product Relationship; Economic
Relationships-The Economic Optimum; Economics of Input Substitution; Economics
of Product Substitution; Agricultural Cost Relationships; Supply Behaviour;
Risk attitudes in agriculture, Optimization under Risk and Uncertainty.
Measurement of Technological Change, Decomposition Analysis, Farm Size and
Productivity; Total Factor Productivity. Agricultural Marketing: Marketable and
Marketed surplus; Market Equilibrium, Product and Input Price, Perfect and
Imperfect Competitions; Market Efficiency, Cost and Price Spread, Agricultural
Trade and WTO; Agriculture in India: Contribution to GDP, Plan Outlay for
Agriculture, Rural Credit Structure, Multi-agency Approach to Rural Credit,
Credit Supply and Gap; Subsidy, Technology, and Market.
